definitions.gloss: split-toe work shoes with rubber soles
definitions.explanation: Ankle-high cloth footwear with a separate big toe and a rubber sole, worn outdoors by construction workers, gardeners and farmers, and at festivals.

examples.japanese: {地下足袋|じかたび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧。
⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地下足袋|じかたび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{神輿|みこし}→神輿：10605_mikoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|かつ}ぐ→担ぐ：03917_katsugu⟧。
examples.english: On festival day we carry the portable shrine wearing jika-tabi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地下足袋|じかたび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}いて→履く：00700_haku⟧、⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身軽|みがる}→身軽：15136_migaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The carpenter, wearing jika-tabi, walked nimbly across the roof.

notes:
The {地下|じか} here means "directly (on the ground)": unlike ordinary ⟦{足袋|たび}→足袋：03730_tabi⟧, which are worn indoors or inside sandals, these are worn on their own as shoes. Despite the kanji, it has nothing to do with ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧ (underground).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地下足袋|じかたび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧: to wear jika-tabi
- {地下足袋|じかたび}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: dressed in jika-tabi

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{足袋|たび}→足袋：03730_tabi⟧: split-toe socks worn with kimono
- ⟦{草履|ぞうり}→草履：04048_zouri⟧: traditional flat sandals
